findings.evidence: "the app reads that file once at start. If the file is absent or its content does not match `^[0-9a-f]{40}$`, `version` is `unknown`." Tests cover absent, empty, wrong case or length and `../x`, but not an unreadable file (permission error, directory, non-UTF-8 bytes, oversized file) and the spec fixes no path or read-size bound.
